5fc1630188e8b9506fdf60af5b5fdb988587d9b0.text_en:
The start button awakens the engine and sometimes also the neighbors, thanks to the rather loud roar sent into the air. Even before setting off, or while driving very slowly as required in my neighborhood, this engine creates, through the sounds it makes in every state, and also the way the RPM even rises a bit, that feeling – demonstrating that even so, it is truly a gem. It's easy to understand why Audi's people insisted not to give it up; it is responsible for much of the thrill this car delivers.
With so many driving modes and sounds, it's a little hard to choose the right setting for the situation and terrain. But in any mode one thing is immediately clear: the output is very strong, produced gradually but determinedly whenever you accelerate the car, and it not only reaches 100 km/h very quickly but continues almost at the same pace toward dawn. Very quickly, sometimes too much so, you discover the car is moving much faster than you think. Monitoring the speedometer is highly recommended.
The unique engine sound entices pressing the accelerator and creates a feeling that you should stay there a little longer. It's definitely tempting, but because the sound and sensation don't change, it's easy to unintentionally reach the redline in low gears in manual mode.

922e09a994f006c7b4af74b7d171fe836aa78bb9.text_en:
The unique engine sound entices pressing the accelerator and creates a feeling that you should stay there a little longer. It's definitely tempting, but because the sound and sensation don't change, it's easy to unintentionally reach the redline in low gears in manual mode.
Overtaking? It laughs at that. Most of the time I find myself slowing down during an overtake so as not to startle the drivers I am passing on their left. The power availability is excellent even in practice, so you can overtake immediately even under load and tough conditions, without downshifting and smoothly. In this mode, that unique sound is not full of popping noises that attract too much attention. I definitely liked that.
The dual-clutch transmission cooperates with the engine, but in normal mode it doesn't shift very quickly, and under load it is politely sluggish. Even at crawling speeds it's not always smooth, despite attempts to improve that behavior, and after all that, it is a powertrain division that is very pleasant even in daily use.
This is not a car intended for economy, meaning, at a daily pace the consumption is reasonable, at 11.2 km/l, but when driving properly, it reached 7.5 km/l.

d05e866ac0e4b162c6662bde8f2ce84b9fe1aa45.text_en:
Compared to today's standards, the RS3 at 1565 kg is not a heavy car, and its dimensions, especially the short wheelbase, orient it, thanks to its dynamic setup, toward very sharp cornering, which is rare nowadays.
The steering is really fast, 1.8 turns lock to lock. It's slightly light in the center area, just before initiating the turn, and when driving very fast in a straight line or on a wavy road, the feeling is that directional stability is affected. The variable steering ratio allows for 'short' steering, but with the start of the turn the transition is not natural.
But the dynamic capability itself is the big story here. The body control under load is excellent, the grip superb, and in addition the rear power delivery and differential's operation are felt.
On the right roads, the heavy front end is sometimes felt when entering a corner without using the throttle – but the continuation can be very different if you touch it. Pressing the throttle, even strongly, causes the rear to push and tighten the turning line in varying doses; excess steering is not like rear-wheel-drive sports cars – but everything behaves well not only under initial load, the car allows raising the pace impressively, allowing entry into it and similar bends a bit faster.
It takes time to learn all the possibilities hidden in 'Individual' mode, 'Performance' mode, and the more extreme 'Rear Torque' mode; it’s worth trying all these in the right places, especially with the last one which is practically a 'drift' mode, and very much recommended with caution. In dynamic modes and on the relevant roads, the RS3 is a car for connoisseurs.
The brakes work excellently with measured response and appropriate strength. They also maintained good condition despite being properly tired.

08fb40c1aee831effbe7f3901aab811a6601da10.text_en:
The turning diameter due to the longitudinal engine layout, the tires, and especially the steering angle, is relatively large, 12 meters; maneuvering ability in the city is not outstanding, requiring attention in U-turns or parking.
The suspension tuning dedicated to controlling body movement under dynamic load is naturally on the firmer side of the scale, so city ride comfort is not excellent. Tires with low sidewalls – so vital for the type of driving mentioned above – do not participate at all in absorbing shocks, allowing them to transmit internally. Nevertheless, at a pace that is not crawling and in the 'Comfort' suspension mode (in the 'RS' package), the result is reasonable, matching the car’s character and mainly not tiring in daily driving.
Outside the city, the car is much more comfortable on roads that are in decent condition or better, but the comfort is noticeably poorer and by a large margin on rough roads. Road and wind noise are prominent.

c1369a6bfde3ef289ee208c54d36a98746f1e10e.text_en:
Every time I come back to my homeland for a visit, I make sure to bother colleagues at the editorial office in advance to arrange some juicy comparative test. In the first years after I left, they still put effort — Miata versus BRZ, Audi S1 versus Mini JCW, Clio Sport, Lexus LC500. Those sorts. "Come on, do the drifts. Someone else will write and shoot." Fun. At least for me.
Over time, the offers became less and less tempting. "There's a Picanto versus an i10, the shwarma is on us" or "some Chinese car versus another Chinese car. Noodles for lunch." This time, it seems, they put in even less effort; "We don’t have anyone to write a long-term test for the EV9 this time and the deadline is close. Take it for a few days. Food on your tab, gas on us." I agreed immediately, then realized I was foolish.
Things seen from there. But still. The Kia EV9 intrigued me back when the first teasers were shown in 2021. A large electric SUV from a mass-market brand then sounded like an ambitious, almost pioneering project. Then came the positive reviews and the 'World Car of the Year' title in 2024. My curiosity only grew.
Recently, I was fortunate to drive in Toronto the closely related but not identical Hyundai Ioniq 9 (still not marketed in Israel); I was deeply impressed by it, but two areas bothered me in its behavior: ride comfort and safety systems. Unfortunately, the EV9 suffers from these too.

8a6fc1277762c9eb64cab5d329346c52cf5bcd31.text_en:
Thanks to the raised height, the driving position is high (what's called 'High Ride'), and in this respect, the feeling in the C3 is closer to what is experienced in a crossover than in a supermini – and for many people, this is a real advantage: it's easier to get in and out, and the position offers a good field of view in all directions. The steering wheel's in-and-out adjustment range is small, but despite that, it is possible to find a good driving position. The front seats are good and comfortable.
At the rear, the door opening is reasonable. Thanks to the raised roof, headroom is very good, and due to generous footwell space, the rear seating is comfortable for two people, although the knee room is "okay" and the seat is short.
The trunk is large, 310 liters, and also includes a spare wheel as mentioned. However, the loading sill is very high, requiring lifting shopping bags high before lowering them into the deep cargo space, which is a less convenient arrangement.

32a756530ed2865df5f94cc7eb621bf04e00cc29.text_en:
The powertrain is new, including a small electric motor that produces its peak torque (5.2 kgm) from zero rpm and engages early to provide the car with reasonable performance. On initial start-up, slight vibration is felt from the 3-cylinder engine, but this disappears as operating temperature rises, and the engine itself is quiet throughout the rev range.
The gearbox operation, by contrast, is not as smooth as that of the outgoing planetary gearbox. The main problem in stop-and-go traffic is noticeable hesitation in its performance. The gearbox has an L mode meant to hold a low gear, but this is carried out ineffectively.
To maintain low fuel consumption, there is an idling stop/start system that cannot be disabled and also disables the air conditioning compressor. However, the biggest annoyance was the regenerative braking that activates whenever the accelerator pedal is released – inefficient, does not save fuel, unnecessary, and causes a jerky ride due to constant braking.
Fuel consumption is very good at 15.5 km/l under intensive test conditions. In daily life, much better consumption can easily be achieved.

176fad5df95cfd220a146a6fb10756e15cd32e97.text_en:
As with other Citroën models, even the smallest car in their range combines shock absorbers with hydraulic cushions at the end of their travel (PHC, in Citroën terms). These provide the C3 with good ride comfort, though not as excellent as other Citroën models that boast these unique suspensions – and it should be noted that the short wheelbase presents a challenge in this area. The main difficulty is dealing with large bumps at any speed. Having said that, the ride comfort in the C3 is among the best in its class. Noise insulation is less successful, with too much road and especially wind noise.
When the road winds and the car is subjected to dynamic load, body roll angles are noticeable but not excessive. Initial body lean occurs in turns but then settles and does not continue, which is a pleasant surprise providing confidence behind the wheel. On such roads, the steering is quite good, although it is a pity that Citroën succumbed to the trend of a squared steering wheel (also due to instrument panel design), which is less comfortable to grip and turn; the brakes are also good.

ea2571c925d55d09ec02fbd2b7ada1c4d0f51aa1.text_en: The safety package includes autonomous emergency braking, lane-keeping assist, speed sign recognition, and adaptive lighting. There is no adaptive cruise control (only regular cruise control). The systems work well without too many beeps, and if one wishes to deactivate them, disengaging lane departure correction and sign recognition is easily done via two physical buttons to the left of the steering wheel. The C3 has not yet been tested in the European crash test.

61870d3b2de3f32f9fef6a9e1a64fc0be5ad2296.text_en:
Another direction was created earlier – large, heavy SUVs. The reverse of a dynamically focused performance car ultimately dominated with the surge of electric vehicles, especially even heavier ones.
Although we had information and knowledge about the Audi RS3, even the refreshed model, and drove it a few months ago, it still surprised us; this is a car that brings with it an intent that used to be a dream for many, requiring significant investment by manufacturers in many details that are not visible but vital for that capability.
In the case of the Audi RS3, that intent and investment have the most prestigious expression in this field: the lap record for a compact car at the Nürburgring, 7:33.23 minutes, taken from the BMW M2.
So yes, very few will buy this car – because it is focused, expensive, targeted from the outset at a very small group who truly want it and can afford it. But cars like this are the ones that make kids dream about them, have brought many of us to love the field in general, and even work in it.
In the transitional period the automotive world is in, cars like the RS3 should no longer exist. They demand too much attention from manufacturers who are busy developing model ranges according to changing air pollution regulations that direct them towards different types of performance and sports cars. But the trio of luxury German brands preserves them, even improves them, because this is part of what made them and gave them their uniqueness.
On the other hand, rumors say that Audi also planned to stop production of this car with the five-cylinder engine when the facelift came due to difficulties meeting new regulations. Relaxation of the regulations kept it in production and allowed the facelift. Hallelujah.

17376b4422953612e366747e65ca0a44a8ed6f50.text_en:
In 1996, Audi launched the A3 family car, the first of its kind from a luxury brand, and along with it, they introduced the sporty S3 version.
In 2011, towards the end of the second generation, Audi added the extreme RS3 hatchback version—powered by the unique 2.5-liter five-cylinder engine. In 2017, with the facelift of the third generation A3, the RS3 joined in a sedan body style. The fourth generation A3 was unveiled in 2020, and the year after, the second generation RS3 was announced; these, alongside the S3, received a facelift in 2024.
And here it is, as before, powered by the unique turbocharged 2.5-liter inline five-cylinder petrol engine.
This engine produces 400 hp at 5600-7000 rpm and 51 kgm at 2250-5600 rpm—creating a very broad and deep power band. The transmission is a 7-speed dual-clutch unit, with all-wheel drive; acceleration to 100 km/h takes 3.8 seconds and top speed is limited to 250 km/h; in the more extreme performance versions, 305 km/h. The car features an active rear differential and an RS Torque Splitter, capable of directing all the rear-drive torque to the outer rear wheel—to reduce understeer, improve grip, and also allow controlled sliding.

29d572dde5f9588ad328b14c3fbf4e4be2fa6e19.text_en:
As part of the facelift, the software controlling the suspension dampers was updated, the steering received variable ratio, and the same active differential was tuned for sportier handling, understeer was reduced through changes in stability control and also thanks to the tires; their sizing is unusual, with the front tires having a wider tread: 265/30-19 at the front, 245/35-19 at the rear. Equally important for the experience: the exhaust flaps open at lower RPMs for a sportier sound there as well.
The Audi RS3 is offered in two body styles, both with a wheelbase of 263.1 cm; the hatchback length is 439 cm and the sedan 454 cm; width is identical at 185 cm, while height differs—143 cm for the hatchback and 141 cm for the sedan.
The price for the Audi RS3 hatchback is 526,000 shekels, and the sedan costs 545,000 shekels, with the latter being tested here.
This car was equipped with the 'RS' package costing 26,000 shekels, which includes electronically controlled dampers, matrix LED headlights, a sports exhaust system, and Napa leather upholstery.

102fe43db90b2ef7363f9a37ec294bb298a2651a.heading_en: The Most Beautiful of the Beast
102fe43db90b2ef7363f9a37ec294bb298a2651a.text_en:
The dark gray RS3 that arrived to us looks fantastic, presenting an excellent blend of aggressiveness at the edges with an elegant appearance and proper proportions. It is far from being a 'wolf in sheep's clothing,' but everything is tastefully done and far from the loudness that characterizes such versions.
The new grille and attractive lighting units give the car a more powerful front than before the update, yet it is not excessive. The same applies to the rear: despite the full 'upgrade menu' with gigantic exhaust outlets protruding from a large diffuser, at the center of which is a slim, new red reflector, along with a spoiler at the edge of the trunk lid, the overall appearance is not overly aggressive. This is not harmed even by the enlarged wheel arches and the more pronounced air intakes. Completing the picture are handsome 19-inch wheels, behind which the red calipers are visible.

ea386d267e6c9aed859b022c63b54e139d0daa91.text_en:
Stepping into the RS3 brings you right into the expected atmosphere – sporty seats that hold well, a correct driving position, complemented by leather upholstery and reddish stitching. The quality of the upper surfaces is less impressive as they feel hard to the touch. The ambient lighting is very pleasing to the eye; however, the small, efficient control knob is less to my personal taste.
The central display does not dominate the driver's environment, which is appropriate for this sort of car. It is sufficiently large (10.1") and the operation is quite comfortable. Even when the smartphone is displayed, there's still a clear column of shortcuts on the side. Wired Android connection is still somewhat disappointing; wireless connection is not possible due to frequencies that the security system does not permit. Climate control has convenient external controls, and a row of buttons is well positioned for easy interface.
The instrument cluster display offers too many scribbled options (some representing the sporty driving modes), but it is also possible to choose a classic display. Controlling information systems through touch buttons on the steering wheel is not very successful, and adjusting volume by touch is somewhat too much for something that should be simple.
On either side of the new steering wheel spokes are two red buttons: the left one controls the more extreme 'Performance' mode, and the right one the more varied 'Individual' mode. Both lead to the interesting but somewhat complex area of controlling driving operation components. We like options like these, but given the car, they require familiarity and learning, also because the options are numerous. We would have liked the basic menu to remain on the display longer.
The safety system obviously gives alerts, but most are not bothersome. Additionally, it is easy to control and disable lane-keeping assistance. When it was active, it frequently alerted me that I was not holding the steering wheel; where did it get that idea? After all, the steering wheel here is so pleasant.

df7f46640e103b5fda6b0bbf30695fe26543b2ee.text_en: There is more legroom in the rear than initially appears and it is reasonable, but headroom is not impressive. The center seat’s structure, the floor with the enlarged drive shaft tunnel, and the whole air conditioning outlet assembly will hinder an adult passenger from sitting comfortably in the middle. The trunk is nicely lined, adequately sized, and efficiently shaped, although its opening is not large.

6ce72fbdfd54a5f85e893ca4a75b51343247a78b.text_en:
With the unveiling of the fourth and current generation of the Citroën C3 in 2023 – 21 years after the model's launch, 7 years after the previous generation was introduced – the French manufacturer announced a change in approach based on four components: boldness, sustainability, comfort, simplicity.
At face value, it sounds like another marketing mambo jumbo, but to understand it you have to read the terms in this context, especially the last one; Stellantis Group, the owner, decided to reposition Citroën within its hierarchy and hence in the automotive world: to offer simple and affordable models. In practice, this continues one of two paths that have characterized Citroën since the days of the 2CV, Ami 6, AX. The second, exclusive path – Traction Avant, DS and XM, CX and C6 – is meant to be reflected in the luxury DS brand.
And since this is the direction, it is appropriate to start with the C3's price which stands at 100,000 shekels for the manual version, 115,000 shekels for the automatic version that we tested. These prices are significantly cheaper than those of competitors, placing the Citroën C3 at an excellent starting point. Now we just need to check the rest.

0aadd3d7caf455ffce51140ab20fef5d43299490.text_en:
The new Citroën C3 is based on an improved version of its predecessor's platform, which during the PSA days (Peugeot, Citroën, DS and Opel) was called CMP; now, within the Stellantis Group (created with the merger of Fiat-Chrysler Group, FCA), it comes in an enhanced edition called Smart Car Platform, serving the Opel Frontera, Fiat Panda and other models.
The C3 is a supermini (B segment), with almost all its dimensions identical to those of the outgoing generation: wheelbase 254 cm, length 401 cm, width 175 – almost identical, except for the height, which increased by 12 cm – which is a lot – to 159 cm, partly due to ground clearance rising from 13.5 cm to 19.5 cm.
The powertrain is taken care of by a new edition of the 1.2-liter 3-cylinder turbo petrol engine common to many Stellantis models and originating from PSA. Two main changes were made to this engine: replacing the timing belt with a timing chain (the oil-immersed timing belt had proved problematic); adding a mild hybrid system that includes an electric motor producing 22 hp and 5.2 kgm. The total output now stands at 110 hp – a first for Stellantis models, identical to the outgoing generation, and Citroën breaks from tradition by not publishing the combined torque figure. The gearbox is also new for the model, used in other models as well: a 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, replacing the outgoing generation's 8-speed planetary automatic, and front-wheel drive is retained. The performance: 9.8 seconds to 100 km/h and 160 km/h top speed (10 seconds and 193 km/h in the previous generation).
The Citroën C3 is offered in automatic only in one equipment level called 'Max,' which includes: LED lighting, 17" wheels, rear parking sensors and reversing camera, rain and light sensors, darkened windows and rear windshield, 7" head-up display, 10.25" multimedia system with wireless Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, wireless charging pad, 4 USB-C ports, single-zone climate control, spare wheel, and more.

2b66c20b4fbb9fb007490a0481260d182198bbb8.text_en:
Let's start with a trivial detail that seems large but is not really important – this is the first Citroën model to feature the new logo, and it is displayed proudly and prominently, if not overly large. It demonstrates striking visibility, although I personally preferred the previous emblem which integrated better into the design.
Regarding the theme of integration and design, I was less connected to this current rendition. There are many distinctive elements, like the recurring 'Chevron' design motif – the inverted 'V', Λ, which characterizes the gear shape developed by André Citroën – initially for the industry, then for vehicles and as part of his logo.
In my opinion, these elements don’t connect well enough into something coherent in the C3, creating a somewhat bland look that leaves no particular impression. Some like the design calmness, but I think it’s less suitable for a budget supermini aimed at a young audience.

9a9b15546c72b18caad5d447708d7dee66cc72bb.text_en:
Entering inside reveals a horizontal dashboard in three layers stretching from door to door. Here too, the 'Chevron' motif appears – on the dashboard, on the gear lever – and here as well the design does not really work, and the feeling is that everything is too big for a supermini.
And speaking of feeling, one cannot shake off the impression they cut corners. There is little fabric across the width of the dashboard, and where you rest your elbows there is a slightly soft, leather-like covering, but everything else is made of hard, grainy, plain plastic. True, Citroën wants and has succeeded in keeping the price low thanks to these savings, but in my opinion that’s one step too far.
This saving is reflected in other details, like the use of a physical key instead of a button, slow response until the engine starts after turning the key, slow response of the trip computer, slow multimedia response and a simple multimedia interface. These examples share the theme of saving on chips to keep production costs as low as possible.

0180af8333aeeb4161c288c6168425056ea8b446.text_en:
This saving is reflected in other details, like the use of a physical key instead of a button, slow response until the engine starts after turning the key, slow response of the trip computer, slow multimedia response and a simple multimedia interface. The common factor in all these examples is the saving on chipsets aimed at keeping production costs as low as possible.
This simplicity also has advantages, as the day-to-day operation is very easy and comfortable to understand, with a very clear instrument cluster and physical buttons for climate control. And for those who need a little encouragement, on each door there is a small red tag, just like on jeans, with English wishes written on them meaning "feel good," "be happy," "be cool," "enjoy." I forced my daughter to read what was written on them just before she left the car and headed to school – she wasn't amused, but I was, and that's enough.
Thanks to the raised ride height ('High Ride'), the driving position is high, and in this regard the feel inside the C3 is closer to what you get in an SUV than in a supermini – and for many people that’s a significant advantage: also because it's easier to get in and out, and the position offers a good field of view in all directions. The steering wheel's in/out adjustment range is small, but despite that a good driving position can be found. The front seats are good and comfortable.

fa6c84b5b0fde24b7272bea42e50ea4920a3a7ea.heading_en: What is the price of the MG S6 in Israel?
fa6c84b5b0fde24b7272bea42e50ea4920a3a7ea.text_en:
Question: What is the price of the MG S6 in Israel?
Answer: The price of the MG S6 Luxury version with rear-wheel drive and a 77 kWh battery is 178,888 shekels.

fc00d3c40d2dde43a1a06c24b7d096c09c1f08d7.heading_en: What is the real-world range of the MG S6 in daily driving?
fc00d3c40d2dde43a1a06c24b7d096c09c1f08d7.text_en:
Question: What is the real-world range of the MG S6 in daily driving?
Answer: Although the official range is 530 km (WLTP), the real-world range is about 420–440 km, depending on driving speed and terrain.

d0d2d8b795f5dbd23f4f003ab79c2ad31905b3ac.heading_en: How long does it take to charge the MG S6?
d0d2d8b795f5dbd23f4f003ab79c2ad31905b3ac.text_en:
Question: How long does it take to charge the MG S6?
Answer: Three-phase home charging (11 kW) takes about 7.5 hours, and fast DC charging from 10% to 80% takes about 38 minutes.

b9ff51444b4cbe56bf9a77472cc0fc5180c0f6e2.heading_en: Is the MG S6 powerful enough for intercity travel?
b9ff51444b4cbe56bf9a77472cc0fc5180c0f6e2.text_en:
Question: Is the MG S6 powerful enough for intercity travel?
Answer: Yes. With 245 hp, acceleration of 7.3 seconds to 100 km/h, and rear-wheel drive, the performance is very sufficient even for overtaking and highway driving.

b0809308cd0e59fcd4ee7c76b97bbb16c907b374.heading_en: What is the size of the MG S6 compared to competitors?
b0809308cd0e59fcd4ee7c76b97bbb16c907b374.text_en:
Question: What is the size of the MG S6 compared to competitors?
Answer: It is a full D-segment SUV: 471 cm length, 284 cm wheelbase, and 493 liters of trunk space – roomier than most electric cars up to 200,000 ₪.

826e335a2398f34f3226ced0fca1aa589d196e48.heading_en: What are the dimensions and performance of the S6?
826e335a2398f34f3226ced0fca1aa589d196e48.text_en:
The MG S6 was introduced in 2025, based on the MSP platform in its current 'Nebula' version. It is a mid-size crossover SUV (D-SUV) with dimensions typical for its category; a wheelbase of 284 cm, length 471 cm, width 192 cm, and height 167 cm. The trunk volume is 493 liters, with an additional 124 liters in the front trunk (102 liters in the dual-motor version).
Two drivetrain versions are offered in the S6. The single-motor/rear-wheel drive version is tested here, as well as the dual-motor and all-wheel drive version. For the first time, the motor produces 245 hp and 35.7 kgm, with acceleration of 7.3 seconds to 100 km/h and top speed of 200 km/h. The battery has an energy capacity of 77 kWh, an official range of 530 km, fast charging power of 144 kW, and home charging with three-phase is 11 kW.
The second motor added at the front produces 361 hp and 55 kgm, with 5.1 seconds to 100 km/h and the same top speed. The official range is 485 km, and battery and charging data are identical.

3bf65f82189bcc8eabf532706a75686c6b13ac11.heading_en: What does the test car include in the 'Leksi' equipment level?
3bf65f82189bcc8eabf532706a75686c6b13ac11.text_en:
MG makes it easy for everyone with two equipment levels, each paired with a different drivetrain. The one with rear-wheel drive has the 'Leksi' equipment level, while the more powerful dual-motor version carries the obligatory 'Performance' title (wow; this was probably the shortest creative meeting in history). The equipment is identical in both and quite impressive; highlights include: a panoramic sunroof with a full curtain(!), seats upholstered in Alcantara combination, electrically adjustable, with the driver's seat sliding backward for easy entry, both heated and ventilated, a head-up display, a 12.8" multimedia screen compatible with wireless Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, wireless charging that, as usual, heats the phone more than charges it, and the option to power external electrical devices. And much more.
In advanced safety features: autonomous braking even when reversing, blind spot vehicle warnings and door opening detection with passing vehicle recognition, lane departure correction, adaptive cruise control, and speed limit sign recognition. Importantly, it received 5 stars in the European crash test.
Warranty is 7 years for the vehicle and 8 years or 150,000 km for the battery.
The price of the test vehicle is 178,888 shekels.

78862582daab14bd89f554da9c811b7cb77a00ad.heading_en: How is the exterior design of the MG S6?
78862582daab14bd89f554da9c811b7cb77a00ad.text_en: The exterior appearance of the S6 does not make new chapters in the book. The front has the matte look and narrow lighting units characteristic of MG models (and actually most Chinese electric cars). Its profile looks station wagon-like, wrapped in all the usual protocols for a crossover appearance including black plastic skirts and even more generic rear styling.

0ca728794dfc4457108df068aa82424d881bf228.heading_en: Is the driver environment of the MG S6 good?
0ca728794dfc4457108df068aa82424d881bf228.text_en:
Remember the reference to MG's previous attempt in this category? Back then, with the Marvel, the manufacturer boasted about the giant vertical touchscreen that centralized all controls. Here there's a near 180-degree turnaround. MG shows here that it is possible to create a beautiful and elegantly designed passenger cabin while still using physical controls. There really are buttons and knobs for the audio system, climate control, air vent direction, and mirror adjustment. Kudos also for the good quality materials and workmanship, even for the texture combination in a strip across the passenger compartment. As a result of the use of physical buttons, you also get better ergonomics with interfaces that are simple and easy to operate—starting from the gear selector, clear information menus controlled from the steering wheel, and even the menu layout on the screen control system with reasonable font size. However, still recorded against it are the tedious alarm cancellation procedures and an embarrassing Hebrew translation: "Hands-free trunk door," "Welcome light," "Find my car’s response," and my favorite: "From last charging", referring to the display of consumption from charging.
The driver's seat adjustment provides a good driving position relative to the steering wheel and pedals, and visibility outward is very good in all directions. It should be noted that the passenger seat does not have height adjustment, only distance and backrest angle. The seats themselves provide good body support and are comfortable.

f3bb6c8d3b86a27ef2c46ecf695d5df841ead905.heading_en: What does the MG S6 offer in the rear seats?
f3bb6c8d3b86a27ef2c46ecf695d5df841ead905.text_en: A high roofline and a generous door provide easy access to the rear row, both for getting in as an adult and for tending to an infant in their seat. The panoramic roof pushes the interior lighting to the corners, so floor lighting is less ideal in darkness. The material quality is similar to up front and legroom and headroom for passengers is excellent. A flat floor makes it easier to squeeze in a very compact third passenger, with heated seats, air conditioning vents, and two charging sockets. I found the upholstery too soft, causing you to 'sink' into it. Others asked for opinions did not mention this as problematic.

4b524919483262ae321def4202ee1c051e79c803.heading_en: Is the MG S6 comfortable for long trips?
4b524919483262ae321def4202ee1c051e79c803.text_en:
Question: Is the MG S6 comfortable for long trips?
Answer: Yes. The multi-link rear suspension, noise insulation, and overall tuning provide a high level of driving comfort, especially outside the city.

5c107def0351ce1333d4327f9c307e44069ef5c4.heading_en: What is the safety level of the MG S6?
5c107def0351ce1333d4327f9c307e44069ef5c4.text_en:
Question: What is the safety level of the MG S6?
Answer: Very high: 5 Euro NCAP stars, with 7 airbags, autonomous braking, adaptive cruise control, lane keeping, and blind spot monitoring.

bf175420a300a30ea73ee7d2ef5e229a7387b66d.heading_en: What does the warranty for the MG S6 include?
bf175420a300a30ea73ee7d2ef5e229a7387b66d.text_en:
Question: What does the warranty for the MG S6 include?
Answer: 7 years vehicle warranty and 8 years or 150,000 km for the battery, generous for the category.

df32e04c76f65658ad054a69550f6fbe583e6738.heading_en: Does the MG S6 have premium equipment?
df32e04c76f65658ad054a69550f6fbe583e6738.text_en:
Question: Does the MG S6 have premium equipment?
Answer: Yes. Includes an opening panoramic roof, heated and ventilated seats (also in the rear), head-up display, surround view cameras, and wireless Apple CarPlay.

54880ad4f54ae313bfc63d0ce593f22a32509ad1.heading_en: Who is the MG S6 best suited for?
54880ad4f54ae313bfc63d0ce593f22a32509ad1.text_en:
Question: Who is the MG S6 best suited for?
Answer: For those looking for a spacious electric SUV, with good range, high comfort, and an attractive price – without compromising on safety and equipment.

942402d700176940ccc5d83b9174dd85cb9b6ef4.text_en: The squared design of the rear section allows for a wide loading opening, and the structure of the trunk itself is comfortable. The wheel arches do narrow it somewhat in the rear part, but the front portion is efficient thanks to compartments with nets for small items. The equipment also includes lighting, hanging hooks, floor rings, and a roll-up shelf from above. As usual, there is no space left for a spare wheel, so take with you a note of a travel prayer just in case.

fb7e9b9689f1597cdd2645ae89ef8859e79ff221.heading_en: Are the performance, electricity consumption, and range of the MG S6 good?
fb7e9b9689f1597cdd2645ae89ef8859e79ff221.text_en:
Generally yes, both in the 245 hp version and with a curb weight of 1.9 tons, the S6 delivers a sufficient and rising driving pace. 7.3 seconds to 100 km/h doesn’t press your head to the headrest, but it is quite enough for any daily use, with power availability and immediacy hardly affected even at higher speeds, making mid-range accelerations very good for effective overtaking. The regeneration mode is calibrated to the maximum setting, providing a level very close to one-pedal driving (here it is worth noting I was happy to discover that the intensity can be adjusted via a shortcut button on the steering wheel).

At the end of the test days, which combined a mix of managerial driving and short dynamic segments, the S6 recorded an average consumption of 5.3 km/kWh (19 kWh/100 km). This is a good consumption for a vehicle of its size and under the test conditions.

The official figure of 520 km is far from what is obtained in actual driving; with us, it stabilized at about 430 km, and even more moderate use would scrape another 20 km, no more. Returning to the long-range test, the average mileage of the 9 competitors was 452 km achieved in a very relaxed managerial drive to Eilat. So in practice, the stated range is very good.

Charging power of 144 kilowatts at public stations may be a disadvantage compared to what is common today, about 20% less than many competitors. On the other hand, proper use of an electric car should not often require you to reach the charging station enough for this to be a problem.

a7c1ba7796eddfcf43d8680b9a008a809004546f.heading_en: How are the comfort and handling of the MG S6?
a7c1ba7796eddfcf43d8680b9a008a809004546f.text_en:
In these areas, there was a more positive surprise even than its ergonomics. We know MG can properly tune cars. We encountered this in the MG 4, which was very impressive dynamically. But whereas that 4 was not particularly comfortable, here we have a vehicle that—except in slow urban driving where it is a bit stiffer than desirable—performs very well with suspensions in other situations. Not only compared to many Chinese cars, some of which are appallingly tuned, but also compared to European, Korean, and Japanese cars. My unfounded assumption is that the European ambitions and British base of the manufacturer contributed to this. Giving up the 20" rim tires at 50 profile for something more appropriate would improve matters.

By the way, for a relatively large car externally and spacious inside, it is quite easy to manage in urban settings, both in terms of maneuverability and outward visibility around the body’s corners. It should be noted that the all-wheel-drive version pays a price in turning diameter (12.4 meters compared to 10.5 in the test car).

Also dynamically, you get a vehicle that can handle not only absorbing bumps and wavy roads but also corners of various types, even when driven aggressively and reasonably with a proper amount of weight on the steering wheel. Using rear-wheel drive "cleans" the steering from the steering fight phenomena that sometimes appear in strong front-wheel-drive electric cars. This also occurs due to the use of a multi-link rear suspension, good Michelin Primacy tires, and again, it is a reminder of MG’s capability compared to some other Chinese competitors in this field.

7757b12b2234424f84e5b13319d624dff2efa3a1.heading_en: Can you take the S6 off-road on trails?
7757b12b2234424f84e5b13319d624dff2efa3a1.text_en: Basically yes, but you can also take a Porsche 911 off-road; whether this is good and correct is another question. In the case of the S6, it simply requires a big compromise in comfort, because as mentioned it is stiff at slow speeds and will not be good or correct to drive there at higher speed.

28ac68949d680d1b5f847fd3521ff11f879b4977.heading_en: MG S6: Advantages, disadvantages, and value for money
28ac68949d680d1b5f847fd3521ff11f879b4977.text_en:
That the Israeli car market is in turmoil is a statement that has been more or less true for tens of years; on the other hand, what isn’t in turmoil here?

But this turmoil is not like its predecessors—in strength, intensity, and essence. Within five years, Chinese-made vehicles became dominant in the Israeli car market, with around thirty brands, a three-digit number of models, and new drive types that became very common. Changes happened even within that turmoil, from huge demand for electric vehicles to a slowdown in their consumption and a transition to plug-in hybrids. Meaning: to sell an electric car today, you need more than a plug icon on the vehicle—you need both a reasonable price and fair value.

At the price of the MG S6, standing at 178,888 shekels, it is definitely at the intersection of these two axes. The S6 offers, like many Chinese models, suitable dimensions and space, rich equipment, and a high safety level, as well as good performance and a reasonable range. To all this it adds better ergonomics than is usual among its peers, driving comfort, and good dynamic capabilities.

Its disadvantages are ride comfort at low speed, glitches in translation, and fast charging that is not very fast.

In summary, on top of the typical advantages of a Chinese electric car and the fair value offered by most of them, the S6 adds two important components in its capability, providing a real advantage compared to its equivalents in price and size.

f47e9ab9e704a2afc0585d84111e781fd85d3284.heading_en: Long-term report: Kia EV9 'GT Line' (Report No. 4) (2/4)
f47e9ab9e704a2afc0585d84111e781fd85d3284.text_en:
Recently I also had the privilege to drive in Toronto the closely related but not identical Hyundai Ioniq 9 (not yet marketed in Israel); I was deeply impressed by it, but two aspects of its behavior disturbed me: ride comfort and safety systems. Unfortunately, EV9 suffers from these as well.
If you have followed the previous chapters, you surely remember that EV9's ride comfort received praise. Well, that's true, but only to a certain limit. Once the road surface becomes truly challenging—such as continuous elevation changes, and especially bumps and asphalt bulges—the large vehicle really shakes its occupants. The human speedometer called "my wife" even complained that a constant swaying frequency was created.
The second issue that stands out in the EV9 troubles me even more, and that is the performance of the safety systems, or more precisely, the nuisance they cause.

6470f8a80a52a805a13b75d8eb8550e52fc1354e.heading_en: Long-term report: Kia EV9 'GT Line' (Report No. 4) (3/4)
6470f8a80a52a805a13b75d8eb8550e52fc1354e.text_en:
The problem with this approach—beyond the incessant buzzing—is that when the system actually warns of a real problem, the driver will ignore it.
This creates a situation where because the systems are too hysterical—"You don’t really need to tell me there’s a car 50 meters behind in the right lane; I’m the one who overtook it"—some turn them off at the start of the trip. If so, why have them at all?
Here I will mention what is known: Kia is not the only manufacturer with models whose safety systems annoy; there are manufacturers (mainly Chinese, but not only) whose models have even more disturbing safety systems.
So for the sake of peace and quiet, they disconnect them—and in the EV9, this requires digging through far too many menus after every start-up. What's annoying is that the "stop to refresh" alert cannot be disabled, and it is triggered, among other things, by the number of times the wheels crossed lane markings on the road. What actually happens is that in such a wide vehicle, in the Tel Aviv metropolitan area that is under constant asphalt renovation, the system may urge the driver to take a refreshment break after five minutes of driving...

939174d79ee167c6cb1a2e415a3595221e49c460.heading_en: Long-term report: Kia EV9 'GT Line' (Report No. 4) (4/4)
939174d79ee167c6cb1a2e415a3595221e49c460.text_en:
So for the sake of peace and quiet, they disconnect them—and in the EV9 this requires digging through far too many menus after every startup. What's annoying is that the "stop to refresh" alert cannot be disabled, and it is triggered, among other things, by how many times the wheels have crossed lane markings on the road. What happens in practice is that in such a wide vehicle, in the Tel Aviv metropolitan area under constant asphalt renovations, the system may urge the driver to take a refreshment break after five minutes of driving...
You can’t see it from here. As mentioned, this is a long-term test, so there is no need to repeat what has been said and analyzed, and mainly to note new or prominent things discovered over time. One of these is the car key that originally was white in color and made of rough plastic. The problem with this combination is that it cannot be cleaned, and it accumulates dirt and looks dirty even when it’s clean.
On the positive side, I note that the front seat headrests are exceptionally comfortable, but after several tens of thousands of km, a slight looseness develops in the seatbacks, and they are not as tight as they were new.
What do we have here? Ultimately, our opinion of the Kia EV9 has not changed: a luxurious and well-equipped leisure vehicle, high-performing and behaves well, spacious with generous range, comfortable (in most conditions) and impressive.
Its main problem is still the high price relative to a popular brand—but in my opinion it certainly offers full value for the premium.
However, if it were my money, I would hesitate to buy any car equipped with such disturbing and cumbersome safety systems to disable.

651ebfce0ce1576c386a3e405039176c81ec0221.text_en:
A few weeks ago we conducted Auto's long-range test for electric cars under 200,000 shekels. The test, as expected of a range test, focused, well, on the cars’ range. But that day also delivered added value, because during it we got to drive 9 of the main electric models in the price range between 150,000 and 195,000 shekels, back to back, and thus created a fairly good basis for comparing these vehicles.
I reflected on that test during the hundreds of kilometers we drove in the new MG S6. It perhaps would not have returned home with the range test winner title—but it seems to me that if it had been there, most participants would have chosen to take it home.

579b2171f7f506c857b711c477129c61cdcf1b6e.heading_en: Where does the S6 fit in MG's lineup?
579b2171f7f506c857b711c477129c61cdcf1b6e.text_en:
In MG’s electric vehicle division, the S6 is currently at the top of the range, positioned below it is the S5 and alongside the MG 4 as the electric compact car alternative. There is also the Cyberster, but we are not in the sci-fi division—rather in that of real cars for real people.
Generally speaking, MG is one of the "oldest" Chinese manufacturers—not because its parent company SAIC was founded in 1955, but because after the looting of British car brands in the early 21st century, it acquired the MG brand with the strategic intent to leverage the brand’s name, its British base, and its knowledge to serve as a springboard into the European market. To clarify: MG, that is Morris Garages, was founded in 1924.
Focusing on the S6, it is a car that replaces the Marvel R in the manufacturer's lineup. The outgoing electric crossover, which to be honest, considering its level of ambition, did not leave much of a mark here either. Priced close to 200,000 shekels, with a range of about 350 km and other gaps, it culminated in about 1,000 units sold during the model's marketing years.

173ed02c0437a89e9c2e7b77e3c97ddd1d9706d6.heading_en: 1. What is special about the Elantra N being offered with a manual transmission?
173ed02c0437a89e9c2e7b77e3c97ddd1d9706d6.text_en:
Question: 1. What is special about the Elantra N being offered with a manual transmission?
Answer: The choice to offer a manual transmission is a rare statement in today's market and reflects a philosophy primarily aimed at the driver and a pure driving experience, in a world where manual transmissions have nearly disappeared.

58ce83199fe3a0e5c75bf0b9281334ca9efafc4b.heading_en: 2. What engine and performance does the manual Elantra N offer?
58ce83199fe3a0e5c75bf0b9281334ca9efafc4b.text_en:
Question: 2. What engine and performance does the manual Elantra N offer?
Answer: A 2.0-liter turbo gasoline engine with 276 hp and 40 kgm, acceleration to 100 km/h in 5.8 seconds, and a top speed of 250 km/h.

ca07e268afc504d7b0da843619eeb9b3a6ebce6c.heading_en: 3. What does the car's dynamic package include?
ca07e268afc504d7b0da843619eeb9b3a6ebce6c.text_en:
Question: 3. What does the car's dynamic package include?
Answer: Electronically controlled dampers, limited-slip differential, chassis reinforcements, Michelin Pilot Sport tires, and steering and brakes tuned for precise sporty driving.

b0ba09c20d6bab57ac135c939ab58ac6ad843984.heading_en: 4. How much does the manual version cost and how does it compare to the automatic?
b0ba09c20d6bab57ac135c939ab58ac6ad843984.text_en:
Question: 4. How much does the manual version cost and how does it compare to the automatic?
Answer: The price stands at 225,000 ₪ – 10,000 ₪ cheaper than the automatic version and cheaper than most direct competitors.

0d1c07751feef946fa1f2061d2159bbd34ac42ff.heading_en: 5. How is the driving experience and dynamic behavior?
0d1c07751feef946fa1f2061d2159bbd34ac42ff.text_en:
Question: 5. How is the driving experience and dynamic behavior?
Answer: The balance, precision, and control are excellent, the steering is quick, the differential works well, and the chassis provides high confidence even at fast pace – a mature and very enjoyable experience.

7c820e977ac6df97c627a9d4a9d0e3a1a35baacc.heading_en: 6. How is the operation of the manual transmission?
7c820e977ac6df97c627a9d4a9d0e3a1a35baacc.text_en:
Question: 6. How is the operation of the manual transmission?
Answer: The transmission is excellent, with a short throw and high precision. The rev-matching system makes downshifting enjoyable, even if the gear ratios are somewhat long.

1239faca4b051cd1a7a7b8b4b34bd9a3efd98baf.heading_en: 7. What is the daily comfort level?
1239faca4b051cd1a7a7b8b4b34bd9a3efd98baf.text_en:
Question: 7. What is the daily comfort level?
Answer: The setup is firm and there is road and wind noise, but in the city the car is quite tolerable and the shocks filter out disturbances better than expected. You can live with it day to day without suffering.

67700ef93e54569ac4fab6d4f07099bbd657f0cf.heading_en: 8. How is the passenger compartment and quality of materials?
67700ef93e54569ac4fab6d4f07099bbd657f0cf.text_en:
Question: 8. How is the passenger compartment and quality of materials?
Answer: The seats are excellent and the driving position is sporty, but there is simple plastic, a manual seat adjustment, no wireless smartphone mirroring, and overall average interior quality.

0ba90a078f06f67cdaab5bdb05d4e5db9ba1f6d2.heading_en: 9. How usable is the car for families and regular trips?
0ba90a078f06f67cdaab5bdb05d4e5db9ba1f6d2.text_en:
Question: 9. How usable is the car for families and regular trips?
Answer: The rear space is reasonable with good legroom but limited headroom and no air conditioning vents. The trunk is practical, but these compromises are understandable considering this is primarily a driver's car.

45e15861bd589dfd232c55234e3f3d401e049517.heading_en: 10. Bottom line, who is the manual Elantra N suitable for?
45e15861bd589dfd232c55234e3f3d401e049517.text_en:
Question: 10. Bottom line, who is the manual Elantra N suitable for?
Answer: For anyone looking for a true manual sports car, with character, an excellent chassis, and a pure driving experience - one of the last opportunities at a realistic price.

c387799bd5b9ee80877b532fc59a6e4964263819.heading_en: Hyundai Elantra N Manual - Road Test (1/10)
c387799bd5b9ee80877b532fc59a6e4964263819.text_en:
1. The Hand of Fate. The past few weeks have reminded us how mysterious the ways of fate and the automotive industry are, thanks to the Hyundai Group. When it landed in our country in the mid-nineties, it was hard to believe that Hyundai would challenge the German luxury manufacturers so deeply and extensively as it did with the Genesis brand, and yet be one of the last to carry the torch of driving pleasure for enthusiasts in the popular segments.
Indeed, Hyundai with its N division and quite a few engineers from Europe is also doing here what is closely associated with esteemed manufacturers on the continent: a division aimed at creating models excelling in dynamic capability and designed to provide a driving experience based on it.
Hyundai demonstrates commitment to this field even through a component related to it but almost vanished from the market: the manual gearbox. This is an excellent reason for another encounter with the model we liked, the Elantra N, offered unusually with such a transmission.
2. Summary. In Israel, the Elantra N takes the place of the i30N, which was marketed here for a short time. This version of the Elantra was introduced in 2021, a year after the seventh generation of this family car, which was also updated in 2023.
The Elantra N features a 2.0-liter turbocharged gasoline engine that produces 276 hp at 5500-6000 rpm and 40 kgm at 2100-4700 rpm. The transmission, as mentioned, is manual with six speeds, and it is front-wheel drive. The acceleration time to 100 km/h for this version is 5.8 seconds (5.3 seconds with the dual-clutch), and the top speed is 250 km/h.

f43da21d06046030c737911eb33aecc1a6f7aa43.heading_en: Hyundai Elantra N Manual - Road Test (2/10)
f43da21d06046030c737911eb33aecc1a6f7aa43.text_en:
The Elantra N features a 2.0-liter turbocharged gasoline engine producing 276 hp at 5500-6000 rpm and 40 kgm at 2100-4700 rpm. The transmission is manual with six speeds, and it is front-wheel drive. The acceleration to 100 km/h in this version is 5.8 seconds (5.3 seconds with the dual-clutch) and the top speed is 250 km/h.
The dynamic specifications include electronically controlled brakes, a limited-slip differential, chassis cross braces, and Michelin Pilot tires sized 245/35-19.
Equipment includes LED lighting, 19" wheels, a glass roof, a smart key, a 10.25" display with cellular pairing, a Bose sound system, and more.
The price of the Hyundai Elantra N is ₪225,000 for the manual version – ₪10,000 less than the automatic Elantra N and cheaper than the i30N’s price, lower than direct competitors from the Volkswagen Group.
3. Aggressive, Black, and Style. "Bro, congrats, we follow cars like this," said two teenagers at a gas station in the south. "Bro, how much power does it have?", "Man, how much does it cost?" others asked. There is no doubt, the manual Elantra N attracted a lot of attention.
It showed up for the test in black that initially looked impressive, but for a traditional person like me, who has grown accustomed to the colors of the Korean sports division's home, it feels less fitting. It creates an aggressive and threatening impression, making the original exterior styling seem excessive, as if it was assembled in a tuning workshop.

516f2a20677318672d86bd26a73e65ff8aa04560.heading_en: Hyundai Elantra N Manual - Road Test (3/10)
516f2a20677318672d86bd26a73e65ff8aa04560.text_en:
It showed up for the test in black that initially looked impressive, but for a traditional person like me, who has grown accustomed to the colors of the Korean sports division's home, it feels less fitting. It creates an aggressive and threatening impression, making the original exterior styling seem excessive, as if it was assembled in a tuning workshop.
And those elements definitely stand out from afar. At the rear, fat exhaust tips and a large spoiler that is not tastefully made stand out. From the wheels, red calipers smile, and the front is even more aggressive than the original, which is hardly modest, and to all these is added a sporty side skirt that combines red lines. There is no chance anyone will ignore this car.

894f57f286328acc93d92b54e753e233a318f738.heading_en: Hyundai Elantra N Manual - Road Test (4/10)
894f57f286328acc93d92b54e753e233a318f738.text_en: 4. Sport with a Purchasing Manager. In recent years, if we have grown used to the few sport versions in the compact-family range still sold looking luxurious inside – see Volkswagen Golf GTI, Cupra Leon VZ, Skoda Octavia VRS – that is not the case here. On the other hand, it is much less expensive – price gaps range from ₪80,000 at the upper end to ₪40,000 for the other two. The Elantra N chooses a direct approach: it deliberately forgoes luxury to reach the driver, the wallet, and the capability.

4ce422fb57a2a1c00343b76a0125293eae77d820.heading_en: Hyundai Elantra N Manual - Road Test (5/10)
4ce422fb57a2a1c00343b76a0125293eae77d820.text_en:
On the other hand, the thick steering wheel, N buttons, and rev-matching control during downshifts clearly announce this is a cabin aimed at the driver. The N menu allows control of the engine, suspension, differential, and exhaust sound. We would have liked quicker and easier access while driving.
The N buttons allow switching between maximum sport mode and two preset programs. It’s a fun play even if the indication of the selected mode is not very prominent. Personally, I would have liked a separate external option to cancel the exhaust noise. Often, I wanted to switch immediately to the maximum mode, but the bangs are too conspicuous in our cautious country.
5. Postures and Views. Even when opening the door, it’s clear this is not just another family car. The seats are deep, the seating position is low and supportive—the feeling is of a driver at the center of affairs. Yet, entry is a bit less comfortable due to the high seats and prominent supports, and the lumbar support adjustment is missing.
At the rear, space is reasonable, legroom is good but headroom is limited, and there are no air vents. The trunk is practical, and the visible reinforcement bars remind that this is a version built seriously and for one purpose: driving.

adae31ac9a8e15c94655dbfee128d4491daa0201.heading_en: Hyundai Elantra N Manual - Test Drive (6/10)
adae31ac9a8e15c94655dbfee128d4491daa0201.text_en:
In the rear, the space is reasonable, with good legroom but limited headroom and no air conditioning vents. The trunk is practical, and the visible reinforcement bars remind you that this is a version built seriously and for one purpose: driving.
6. Horses on the road. In today's era, a power output of 276 hp is not very impressive when it comes to a sporty car. And it's not just this figure. In practice, when accelerating hard to exploit all the potential, there are limitations due to a clutch engagement point that is too sharp, a throttle that isn’t reactive enough in normal mode, and an engine lacking power at very low RPM. Therefore, to launch properly, you have to bring the engine to its effective RPM range (also to avoid embarrassing power loss) or activate 'Sport' mode, which slightly raises the RPM, even at idle, and improves the situation.
The manual shifter has a pleasant short throw, and together with the red button that adjusts the RPM when downshifting, the gear changes are truly enjoyable.
The engine's behavior is not jumpy, but the Elantra N manual is definitely quick. This engine, unlike those from the Volkswagen group, likes to be brought out of the low RPM range into mid-range and to stay a bit longer in lower gears. Then it performs better and responds in a more enjoyable manner.

fcf9f87e69455b0c601ecbb0d732485802ac7049.heading_en: Hyundai Elantra N Manual - Test Drive (7/10)
fcf9f87e69455b0c601ecbb0d732485802ac7049.text_en:
The engine's behavior is not jumpy, but the Elantra N manual is definitely quick. This engine, unlike those from the Volkswagen group, likes to be brought out of the low RPM range into mid-range and to stay a bit longer in lower gears. Then it performs better and responds in a more enjoyable manner.
Yes, the car can cruise at low RPM, but mid-range accelerations are not brilliant then – and it is definitely better to downshift. Then, as the RPM rises, the engine also produces a more pleasant sound, and mainly the passing ability improves. The gaps between second and third gear are somewhat annoying and shorter gear ratios would be preferable, but overall it is fun to work with the car.
Fuel consumption ranges between 13.6 km/l during cruising and 9.6 km/l on the test day, which naturally included demanding sections. Definitely decent for such a car.
7. As it should be, as desired. The strong point in the Elantra N, as it should be in such a car, is its dynamic capability. What is beautiful about it is its balance under heavy load and the mature and precise way it handles corners and curves.
The quick steering results in decisive but not exaggerated directional changes. At high RPM and load, one can feel just a touch of steering resistance (really just a touch) that emphasizes cornering skills and does not truly bother.

856591ba124f34beb0bc7d95b9242cec8f8f364d.heading_en: Hyundai Elantra N Manual - Test Drive (8/10)
856591ba124f34beb0bc7d95b9242cec8f8f364d.text_en:
The quick steering results in decisive but not exaggerated directional changes. At high RPM and load, one can feel just a touch of steering resistance (really just a touch) that emphasizes cornering skills and does not truly bother.
The N model has a limited-slip differential; it is not overly aggressive, it operates naturally and moderately, and is noticeable especially when reaching very fast corners. All this leads to the N not losing front grip and being able to respond to weight transfer with graceful steps. It does not exaggerate this (sometimes I wished for more), but unlike many other cars it can do this even when the corners become very fast. Sometimes I regret that it isn't a bit more "playful," yet it’s still fun to experience the tightening of the line inside a corner, a trait that has almost disappeared from our world.
The brakes are also good, with proper bite, measured responses, and they are not too sharp. Their operation also integrates into the feeling that the people who developed the car knew what they wanted, and they made them better than in the i30.
8. On the way to work. Comfort is not the strong side of the Elantra N. The suspension is firm, the tires are sporty, and road and wind noise are noticeable, especially at high speeds. Yet, in the city and for daily use, the car is quite acceptable, and the shock absorbers manage to filter irregularities better than expected.

aa6dff771f01ff1db356dfca9ee0312b20da8d38.heading_en: Hyundai Elantra N Manual - Test Drive (9/10)
aa6dff771f01ff1db356dfca9ee0312b20da8d38.text_en:
8. On the way to work. Comfort is not the strong side of the Elantra N. The suspension is firm, the tires are sporty, and road and wind noise are noticeable, especially at high speeds. Yet, in the city and for daily use, the car is quite acceptable, and the shock absorbers manage to filter irregularities better than expected.
Outside the city, the ride improves, although it remains on the sporty side of the scale. This is not a pampering car, but it is one you can certainly live with day-to-day without suffering.
9. The Society for the Protection of Nature. "I want to be a permanent member of the Society for the Protection of Nature, to protect animals that are slowly disappearing from the world," wrote the late Shmulik Chizik and Minister Ariel Zilber.
It is a pity that cars like the Elantra N have become rare, and that such a manual version is an endangered species. In a proper world, the authorities should have come to its defense, preserving the breed for future generations. And when the people at Hyundai act accordingly, offering N models in general, and here with a manual transmission in particular, they deserve respect. No less.
There are almost no direct competitors in this field. Essentially, it is the Octavia RS Sedan, but also the Golf GTI and Leon VZ hatchbacks – all family category cars. These are very different machines by nature and... with no manual option.

c0c95ae1e0f97ed679c4a1283039f552c680eede.heading_en: Hyundai Elantra N Manual - Test Drive (10/10)
c0c95ae1e0f97ed679c4a1283039f552c680eede.text_en:
There are almost no direct competitors in this field. Essentially, it is the Octavia RS Sedan, but also the Golf GTI and Leon VZ hatchbacks – all family category cars. These are very different machines by nature and... with no manual option.
The Elantra is a very different breed – not a car that combines sportiness with luxury appointments and creating a space with elements from the luxury world, and in its manual version, it is more of a sporty model in a family body. The Elantra N is less pampering and therefore appeals to a narrower audience looking for the direct enjoyment of driving, not a refined edition of the model.
10. And the price. And we must finish with the price; the Elantra N manual costs 225,000 shekels, and its price is 45,000 shekels cheaper than the i30N that arrived here two years ago, with the same price gap and also much cheaper than the direct competitors mentioned above.
So yes, it is not elegant in appearance, not luxurious in equipment – but it provides driving fun, and definitely fits the phrase "fast before it runs out."

6ac2dbea9230c4f04d31aa43f1f37f04dc9514e5.text_en:
On a sunny day, the display suffers from reflections, and when passing under bridges, the display goes into a too dark mode for too long, and then it may appear too bright. The multi-function sound system offers only preset sound processing modes and the volume adjustment from the steering wheel is not gradual.
The car also has air fresheners in several scents. Perhaps to test this, the supervision summoned a garbage truck that sprayed waste juices behind us. An intense experience against which the air freshener was not effective.
The speed warning is less intrusive, as is the steering correction, which proves to be stubborn and inconsistent. The adaptive cruise control is not smooth and exaggerates remarks about steering grip (I gripped, commander...).
The driver's seat is nice, appears comfortable, but the adjustable lower back support is not precise. The driving position is not successful also because the elliptical and odd steering wheel is often too low and too close.

49f49c3ba4f560b56f3076cd6fb6e70e07f36a09.heading_en: What is going on in the back?
49f49c3ba4f560b56f3076cd6fb6e70e07f36a09.text_en:
Entering the rear is not very convenient due to the thickness and height of the sill and the sloping pillar. However, contrary to the norm, even in the back the material quality is rich, creating a respectable atmosphere. The space there is large, with impressive legroom and headroom, and the ability to recline the backrest over a wide range adds to usability. High-quality trays pulled out from the armrests should be noted.
The trunk does not have a cover to allow the backrest to tilt, but we have already seen solutions to such things. The compartment is efficient for use and the loading area is large, but the floor is relatively high. There is a large space under the floor but its structure impairs usability. The front trunk is not efficient.

4ee1a9b95f5ab2487738df5f3ed843289230cdf1.text_en: Unlike some of its competitors, the HT does not boast outstanding output figures, and 245 hp and 31.5 kgm in electric drive are not impressive numbers today in this context. Nevertheless, as the wise say, it's good to keep proportions (also because, after all, 7.1 seconds to 100 km/h). The performance is good in all driving modes, allowing nice acceleration and especially light intermediate accelerations for immediate overtaking. The sensation, due to the linear operation of the motor and absence of aggressive behavior, disguises very good speed buildup.

3544259552411d8c2a89a7e86fde4bc8d95a9e8a.text_en: The vehicle was driven when the registered range was 445 km. On the intercity road, at traffic pace and comfortable weather, consumption stood at 5 km/kWh for an actual range of 370 km, about 85% of the declared range. After several shorter and more demanding sections, consumption dropped to 4.7 km/kWh, about 350 km. Of course, the more the driving route is urban, the larger the range will be.

00c5c0b84d7c416d989e7c2cf5d93c27dfd68cc2.heading_en: Is the HT a comfortable vehicle?
00c5c0b84d7c416d989e7c2cf5d93c27dfd68cc2.text_en:
In the city, the ride comfort the HT provides to passengers is good as long as it's small disturbances. When disturbances are medium or higher, including a sequence of speed bumps, the body movements after encountering them are not dampened, and the vehicle moves up/down, which accordingly hurts ride comfort. Even on intercity roads, ride comfort deteriorates due to the same lack of damping evident in passing over speed bumps, and a soft damper calibration may cause the car to bounce on road joints. Wind noise insulation is good, and road noise is suppressed in the city but can be heard to increase outside according to asphalt type.
On off-road driving, the same suspension tuning causes the movement there to be not particularly pleasant. However, the vehicle conveys decent structural robustness.
The dynamic capability is solid, but the soft suspension tuning and absence of immediate damping create a car that invites calm driving on winding roads. The steering allows clear change of direction from the start of the turn, but it is a bit heavy when switching from a straight line to it.
Braking capabilities are good, but the feel is that the braking action is not sharp under dynamic load. The regenerative braking action is not very smooth and not strong enough under normal driving conditions.

b560fb3b3ff89a683d8cecac74d1d77e84a17c2c.text_en:
A few months ago, the electric models from GAC, the fifth largest automotive corporation in China, returned to Israel. GAC is state-owned, one of the oldest there (founded in 1948), and in China, it partners with Honda and Toyota.
This corporation was among the first to present here at the start of the decade, and in 2020 it began operations in Israel. However, after a year everything stopped – and now it is marketed here under Orion Mobility from the Union Group, Toyota and Lexus importers who had also imported it previously. This move is the result of a series of improvements aimed at bringing the manufacturer's models also to Europe.
As part of this, the brand Aion was announced, its logo and fonts were changed, the design was updated, the positioning and price level are different, and now there are several models.

49b4db94be6431e0683df09427512552b65966c0.heading_en: What are this brand and model?
49b4db94be6431e0683df09427512552b65966c0.text_en:
Aion is a young brand of GAC, established in 2020 as part of GAC New Energy. In addition to it, a luxury brand was announced in 2022 named 'Hyper', which was replaced in 2024 by Hyptec. What's the connection?
Well, the connection is that the Aion HT model launched in 2023 is offered in China under Hyptec; here, too, this name is placed on the rear of the vehicle and has a different logo. This is also a reason why it is the most expensive among the Aion models here, and accordingly, it has a rear-wheel drive layout; the Y and V models that arrived and the UT model to join have front-wheel drive.
The HT model is imported here in quantities up to 400 units, and the manufacturer is considering transferring it to full European certification. At this stage, the vehicle lacks several modern safety systems, and the safety equipment rating according to the Ministry of Transportation is 4 out of 8.

c8b83f528952db566360e001bbe9e678160a6f5b.text_en:
The Aion HT is a medium-sized coupe SUV (D-SUV). Its dimensions are at the upper side of the category; wheelbase 293.5 cm, length 494 cm, width 192 cm, and height 170 cm. The trunk volume is also large, 670 liters, 1802 liters with the seats folded, and there is an additional front compartment with a volume of 70 liters. The weight is significant, 2080 kg.
The HT has a rear motor producing 245 hp and 31.5 kgm, acceleration to 100 km/h in 7.1 seconds, and a top speed of 183 km/h.
The vehicle has a 72.7 kWh battery, a declared range of 445 km, and a fast charging power of 163 kW. In China, there is also a higher power version (345 hp) and larger batteries (up to 99.5 kWh), and there is no dual-motor version.
This model is offered in one trim level, with the specification including: LED lighting, 19" wheels, glass roof, smart key, electric operation for the rear door and front seats which feature ventilation and massage, including a footrest for the passenger, a 14.6" screen, cellular connectivity and wireless charging, dual-zone climate control with rear air vents.
The price of the Aion HT is 187,000 shekels.

d5733e333ef62abcbd419a5a5300f7775b3dad90.text_en:
At the top of GAC's design pyramid are two: Fan Zhan, who in his youth was the first Chinese designer to work at Mercedes, and recently Benoît Jacob joined him, a veteran figure who grew in Renault's design departments and served in senior roles at Audi and BMW.
Benoît also has extensive experience in China, also as Vice President of design at Nio. The head of the European design center in Milan is Stéphane Janin, who arrived in 2021 from the Renault Group, where he was responsible for concept cars for Renault, Alpine, and Dacia, and later moved to Infiniti.
By its dimensions, the HT is a large vehicle, but the design makes it not appear so; it looks similar in size to the XPeng G6 and Tesla Model Y, but they are smaller than it. It is a coupe SUV, but the design is not fully decisive in this category, and mainly its overall appearance lacks character. Its lines are similar to those of the Renault Arkana but less distinctive, and the frameless doors for the windows do not change much.

155cd1c5b159b8f7773ff212d019aa964a439218.text_en:
The driver's environment in light tones looks pleasant and quality and, of course, is free of switches. Leather upholstery and brown Alcantara covering the ceiling and pillars create a rich and dignified atmosphere. However, the upper surfaces around the driver are made of material that is too hard. There is no glove compartment, but there is a compartment between the seats continuing to a massive console on which there is space for charging/placing the cellphone. It is a pity that the surface does not hold the device sufficiently.
Adjusting the side mirrors via the screen is inconvenient, as is the Chinese habit of hiding the warning indicator in the ceiling, where one expects to find the operation for the glass roof cover (which is on the screen). This caused incorrect activation of the unfocused map lights several times. Also, the positions of the electric buttons for opening the door and operating the windows are strange, as are the recessed door handles which are not pull-out and require pulling.
In the center of the driver's environment is a large 14.6" screen that controls everything, while the projected indicators are positioned, contrary to standard, above the steering wheel height. The climate control is operated via the screen, and its shortcuts are inconvenient also because the screen is not sufficiently touch-sensitive and the system's operation is inconsistent. This demonstrates that the distribution of functions in the menus is confusing. So, in the energy and consumption menus are the driving modes. Braking force of regenerative braking and stability control locking (which automatically reactivates) can only be controlled in the personal 'custom' mode.

9b2837b241fd4c97b1989f330ada34f8c5fb4873.heading_en: What is the safety rating of the vehicle in Euro NCAP?
9b2837b241fd4c97b1989f330ada34f8c5fb4873.text_en:
Question: What is the safety rating of the vehicle in Euro NCAP?
Answer: Lynk & Co 01 received the maximum rating of 5 stars in the Euro NCAP test in 2021, with high scores: 96% in adult occupant protection, 87% in child protection, 71% in pedestrian protection, and 81% in safety assist systems.

5810b814c112e099472a0e0ff01b5f30263595ab.heading_en: How long does it take to charge the vehicle?
5810b814c112e099472a0e0ff01b5f30263595ab.text_en:
Question: How long does it take to charge the vehicle?
Answer: Home (AC) charging takes 2.5 hours with an 11-kilowatt charger. It is important to note that the vehicle does not support fast (DC) charging.

42f7980150a9d565996e8152018a4d4fb85f8a10.heading_en: What engine does the 2026 Lynk & Co 01 have?
42f7980150a9d565996e8152018a4d4fb85f8a10.text_en:
Question: What engine does the 2026 Lynk & Co 01 have?
Answer: The vehicle is equipped with a plug-in hybrid powertrain combining a 1.5-liter turbo gasoline 4-cylinder engine (HORSE engine, a joint project of Renault and Geely) with an electric motor. The combined output is 280 hp and 54.6 kgm, a significant improvement over 261 hp and 43.3 kgm in the outgoing model.

af83613cc3924e05e71d36a752455a2e27ed9e5a.heading_en: What are the dimensions of the Lynk & Co 01?
af83613cc3924e05e71d36a752455a2e27ed9e5a.text_en:
Question: What are the dimensions of the Lynk & Co 01?
Answer: Length: 454 cm, width: 186 cm, height: 169 cm. Wheelbase: 273 cm. The vehicle is classified as a compact C-SUV.

49c0dd5f9d887d9b4856ff37a9a1a83314027eb2.text_en:
Question: Is there a spare wheel?
Answer: No, the vehicle does not include a spare wheel in the trunk.

ff4418b34b6aae4e8a9e52d1e0df869d9d10a6a9.text_en:
The most significant change made with the model renewal is, as mentioned, in the power unit. The 01 parts ways with Volvo’s unit, and the gasoline engine is new, developed by HORSE – the joint venture of Renault and Geely. The turbo-gasoline engine retains the displacement, 1.5 liters, but not the architecture: now 4 cylinders instead of 3 in the previous version. Alongside it operate two new and more powerful electric motors than before: one responsible for propulsion and the other serving as a generator.
The engine replacement created a new power balance, characteristic of this type of drivetrain in its Chinese version: the gasoline engine’s power dropped from 180 to 139 hp, while the electric motor’s output jumped to 145 hp compared to 81 hp in the outgoing model. Bottom line: the 01 has strengthened with a combined output of 280 hp and 54.6 kgm compared to 261 hp and 43 kgm in the pre-update model.
Besides the different engines, the transmission is also different; instead of a 7-speed dual-clutch, there is now a dedicated hybrid automatic, DHT, which has three gears with an electronically controlled multi-plate clutch and a new location; between the drive chain and the wheels, to create gear ratios also for the electric motor.
The battery is different although the specifications (almost) remain unchanged; the energy is now 17.7 kWh (previously 17.6 kWh) and the declared range remains at 75 km.

97df06569e5239f765b29f2bfe3c351a75c2e605.text_en:
The battery is different although the specifications (almost) remain unchanged; the energy is now 17.7 kWh (previously 17.6 kWh) and the declared range remains at 75 km.
All of this set of changes is reflected in a very brisk launch from a standstill thanks to the electric motor up to a speed of 30 km/h, where a slight hesitation is felt until the gasoline engine joins the effort. This is a bit strange, but in any case, the performance of this power unit is better than its predecessor (7.7 seconds to 100 km/h, compared to 8.0 seconds), and mainly it is balanced and good, providing high ability in mid-range acceleration for speed buildup and overtaking.
In practice, the management of electric propulsion improved the actual range; now 68.5 km on electricity alone, compared to 63 km in the test we conducted for the replaced model.
Fuel consumption is also better, averaging 15.6 km/l, and it is just a pity that the 01 still does not offer fast charging (DC) available in competitors like the BYD Seal U or the JAC 7, with home charging rate standing at 6.6 kilowatts.

67e338162aee80b137b8d22970cb3854d56fd2bf.text_en:
As part of the changes made to the 01 in the local offering, the wheel rims dropped in size (to 19"), the tire sidewall height increased and the tire size is now 235/50-19. Such a change is supposed to improve ride comfort, but in practice the difference is not large. The initial tuning is still somewhat firm, and there is almost constant vibration over various asphalt cracks. On the other hand, other irregularities – like potholes, even relatively large ones, or speed bumps – are filtered very convincingly at any speed including off-road driving. Beyond that, road and engine noise insulation is good, but there is wind noise probably coming from the roof rails.
